<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const sortSelect = document.querySelector("select.sortby");
    const categorySelect = document.querySelector("select.category");
    const priceRangeSelect = document.querySelector("select.price_range");
    const stockSelect = document.querySelector("select.stock");
    const pageLengthSelect = document.querySelector("select.page-length-select");
    const clearFiltersBtn = document.querySelector(".clear-filters-btn");

    const url = new URL(window.location.href);

    // Restore selected values from URL
    const sortBy = url.searchParams.get("sort_by");
    const category = url.searchParams.get("category");
    const priceRange = url.searchParams.get("price_range");
    const stock = url.searchParams.get("stock");

    if (sortSelect && sortBy) {
        sortSelect.value = sortBy;
    }

    if (categorySelect && category) {
        categorySelect.value = category;
    }

    if (priceRangeSelect && priceRange) {
        priceRangeSelect.value = priceRange;
    }

    if (stockSelect && stock) {
        stockSelect.value = stock;
    }

    const pageLength = url.searchParams.get("page_length");
    if (pageLengthSelect) {
        // 8 is the server-side default (see page_data_script), so it's the fallback here too
        pageLengthSelect.value = pageLength || "8";
    }

    function updateUrl() {
        const url = new URL(window.location.href);

        if (sortSelect?.value) {
            url.searchParams.set("sort_by", sortSelect.value);
        } else {
            url.searchParams.delete("sort_by");
        }

        if (categorySelect?.value) {
            url.searchParams.set("category", categorySelect.value);
        } else {
            url.searchParams.delete("category");
        }

        if (priceRangeSelect?.value) {
            url.searchParams.set("price_range", priceRangeSelect.value);
        } else {
            url.searchParams.delete("price_range");
        }

        if (stockSelect?.value) {
            url.searchParams.set("stock", stockSelect.value);
        } else {
            url.searchParams.delete("stock");
        }

        if (pageLengthSelect?.value && pageLengthSelect.value !== "8") {
            url.searchParams.set("page_length", pageLengthSelect.value);
        } else {
            url.searchParams.delete("page_length");
        }

        // Reset page when filters change
        url.searchParams.delete("page");

        window.location.href = url.toString();
    }

    sortSelect?.addEventListener("change", updateUrl);
    categorySelect?.addEventListener("change", updateUrl);
    priceRangeSelect?.addEventListener("change", updateUrl);
    stockSelect?.addEventListener("change", updateUrl);
    pageLengthSelect?.addEventListener("change", updateUrl);

    clearFiltersBtn?.addEventListener("click", () => {
        window.location.href = window.location.pathname;
    });
});
</script>
